tldr: Moon in the 2nd house: emotional needs and comfort center on money, values, and self-worth
body: Moon in the 2nd house: emotional needs and comfort center on money, values, and self-worth. Gift: deep feeling there. Watch: moods ride on it. With the Moon in the 2nd house, emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety move through money, resources, values, possessions, and self-worth. This makes how you earn, hold, spend, and define what is worth protecting a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs. Left unconscious, it can become mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs expressed through livelihood and value.
challenge: mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area concentrated in livelihood and value.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
